newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Southern Life invests in housing project.
newsitem.headline: Southern Life invests in housing project.

text.p: South African insurer Southern Life said on Tuesday it had invested 45 million rand in a deal aimed at providing working capital loans of 100 million rand for low income housing projects.

The move, agreed with the National Urban Reconstruction and Housing Agency, was sealed by Southern's Futuregrowth portfolio of funds that invests in schemes associated with the country's Reconstruction and Development Programme (RDP).

Southern's contribution will be added to by 15 million rand worth of gaurantees from the Open Society Institute of New York and the total 60 million rand facility will be available to suport loans of 100 million rand to medium size building contractors.
Southern said that the investment should release about 200 million rand of working capital loans over its lifetime, resulting in about one billion rand worth of housing construction.
"We have developed considerable in-house expertise to minimise the risks which are normally associated with low income housing finance," said Southern chief executive Cedric de Beer.
